translations.web: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”
translations.bsb: Then prepare a tasty dish that I love and bring it to me to eat, so that I may bless you before I die.”
translations.kjv: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
translations.asv: And make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat. That my soul may bless thee before I die.
